--Demographics

SELECT
CustomerID
,CustomerName
,GlobalCIF
,EntityCIF
,CustomerType
,Birthdate
,MaritalStatus
,Gender
,MobileNumber
,EmailAddress
,AddressLine1
,AddressLine2
,City
,Province
,ZipCode
,Country
,EmployerName
,OfficeAddressLine1
,OfficeAddressLine2
,OfficeCity
,OfficeProvince
,OfficeZipCode
,OfficeCountry
,Industry
,Occupation
,Tenure
,DataPrivacyConsent
,LastKYCDate
,RiskRatingType
,RiskRating
,SuspendedIndicator
,ATMEnrollmentIndicator
,MBKEnrollmentIndicator
,RIBBOBEnrollmentIndicator
,PayrollIndicator
,GenerationalCohort
,MarketSegment                                                                                                                             
FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Retail 
WHERE CustomerID = 'R00033040'


--Measures
SELECT
CustomerID
,TotalRelationshipBalance_Prorated
,TotalMTDADBPHPDeposits_Prorated
,TotalYTDADBPHPDeposits_Prorated
,TotalOutBalPHPDeposits_Prorated
,TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_Prorated
,TotalOutBalPHPLoans_Prorated
,TotalCreditLimitLoans_Prorated
,TotalOutBalPHPCards
,TotalOutstandingBalanceCards
,TotalCreditLimitCards
,TotalRelationshipExposureLoansCards_Prorated
,TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSEC_Prorated
,TotalFundValueTrust_Prorated
,TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRY_Prorated                                                                                                                     
FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Retail 
WHERE CustomerID ='R00033040'

---Activities

--CARDS--

--check unique CustomerID in Cards
SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID FROM DW.CI_Cards_Retail_Random_Test

---check CustomerID in Cards vs Demogs
SELECT * FROM DW.CI_Cards_Retail_Random_Test
INNER JOIN DW.CI_Demographics_Retail ON DW.CI_Cards_Retail_Random_Test.CustomerID = DW.CI_Demographics_Retail.CustomerID

SELECT TotalCreditLimitCards FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Retail
WHERE TotalCreditLimitCards IS NOT NULL

 SELECT CustomerID FROM DW.CI_Cards_Retail_Random_Test
 WHERE CustomerID LIKE 'R%' OR CustomerID LIKE 'P%';

--random check
SELECT *
---OpenedDate, ProductType, CreditLimit                                                                                                                           
FROM DW.CI_Cards_Retail_Random_Test
WHERE CustomerID = '000000000101466'---not available in Demogs


--DEPOSITS--
SELECT
OpenedDate, ProductType, OutstandingBalance_Prorated                                                                                                                            
FROM DW.CI_Deposits_Retail_Random_Test
where CustomerID = 'R00033040'----'R01581322'; --- ATM Savings for this CustomerID

--LOANS--

--check unique CustomerID in Loans
SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID FROM DW.CI_Loans_Retail_Random_Test

---check CustomerID in Loans vs Demogs
SELECT * FROM DW.CI_Loans_Retail_Random_Test
INNER JOIN DW.CI_Demographics_Retail ON DW.CI_Loans_Retail_Random_Test.CustomerID = DW.CI_Demographics_Retail.CustomerID

--random check
SELECT
OpenedDate, ProductType, CreditLimit_Prorated
FROM DW.CI_Loans_Retail_Random_Test
where CustomerID = 'R00033040';

--SECURITIES--
--check unique CustomerID in Securities
SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID FROM DW.CI_Securities_Retail_Random_Test

---check CustomerID in Securities vs Demogs
SELECT * FROM DW.CI_Securities_Retail_Random_Test
INNER JOIN DW.CI_Demographics_Retail ON DW.CI_Securities_Retail_Random_Test.CustomerID = DW.CI_Demographics_Retail.CustomerID

--random check
SELECT
OpenedDate, ProductType, PortfolioSize_ProRated
FROM DW.CI_Securities_Retail_Random_Test
where CustomerID = 'R01651487';

SELECT TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSEC_Shared FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Retail

SELECT TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSEC_Shared FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Retail
WHERE  TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSEC_Shared IS NOT NULL


--TREASURY--
--check unique CustomerID in Treasury
SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID FROM DW.CI_Treasury_Retail_Random_Test

---check CustomerID in Treasury vs Demogs
SELECT * FROM DW.CI_Treasury_Retail_Random_Test
INNER JOIN DW.CI_Demographics_Retail ON DW.CI_Treasury_Retail_Random_Test.CustomerID = DW.CI_Demographics_Retail.CustomerID

--random check
SELECT
OpenedDate, ProductType, OutstandingInvestment_Prorated
FROM DW.CI_Treasury_Retail_Random_Test
where CustomerID = 'R00000473';

--TRUST--
--check unique CustomerID in Trust
SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID FROM DW.CI_Trust_Retail_Random_Test

---check CustomerID in Trust vs Demogs
SELECT * FROM DW.CI_Trust_Retail_Random_Test
INNER JOIN DW.CI_Demographics_Retail ON DW.CI_Trust_Retail_Random_Test.CustomerID = DW.CI_Demographics_Retail.CustomerID

--random check
SELECT
OpenedDate, ProductType, AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Prorated
FROM DW.CI_Trust_Retail_Random_Test
where CustomerID = 'R00394172';


---Segments
SELECT
count(*)                                                                                                                     
FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Retail 
where MaritalStatus = 'Married'

--Total Customer Count
SELECT
count(*)                                                                                                                     
FROM DW.CI_Demographics_Retail
